messages.subject: Large dataset issues
parts:
I am developing a dashboard app which requires a large dataset to load globally. Unfortunately, I'm quite novice. I can get the app to load and run from Rstudio but my attempts to get the app functional on the server side haven't been possible yet. The app appears to time-out. 

I've modified all the settings to allow for the initial load of the dataset and have attempted different data structures to no avail. My current script loads the data using data.table and fread.

Any suggestions would be greatly appreciated.

Hi,

How big is your dataset? Does the app run if you only try to upload only a small chunk of it? In any case, with the little information you provide, it might make sense to load your dataset into a database: mongo, ES, Postgres, SQL ... and then query the DB from the app.

Carlos
